title: Osaka: flea market, Shinsekai, castle by night
call: The best day of the week, confirmed this morning. Sunny all day with no rain: 21° at 09:00 for the Shitennō-ji flea market, 24° at midday in Shinsekai, clear skies and 20° at 18:00 for Umeda Sky at sunset (17:05), and about 19° for the castle at night, with some cloud by 21:00. A fresh north breeze, 4 to 5 m/s, so a light layer for the rooftop and the evening.
